_readme: Edit badge names/descriptions freely: the server reads this at startup. wordTiers award by total words written (min). usage badges award ONCE the first time a committed story line matches: 'triggers' fires on ANY listed word/phrase; 'combos' fires when EVERY word of one listed combination appears in the same line, in any order. A badge may carry either or both (case-insensitive, whole words; a trailing ? or ! in a trigger is required literally). Unlocks announce in session chat and toast every connected player. Keep ids stable: they're stored on user accounts. usageOpen badges work exactly like usage ones but are NOT secret: their descriptions show before they're earned.

wordTiers.name: 🔫 There. Out Loud.
wordTiers.desc: Made an account. Said it: there, out loud.

wordTiers.name: 🫶 You have explored (like Mike, offscreen)
wordTiers.desc: Write 15,000 words. You have explored, like Mike, offscreen.

wordTiers.name: ☁️ I miss clouds I miss you
wordTiers.desc: Write 35,000 words. I miss clouds. I miss you.

wordTiers.name: 😤 It's not my fault you don't like girls!
wordTiers.desc: Write 75,000 words. It's not my fault!

wordTiers.name: 🌀 Crazy Together
wordTiers.desc: Write 150,000 words. If we're both going crazy, we'll go crazy together.

usage.name: 🐺 Omega Badge
usage.desc: Write “puppy” into a story line. Good boy.

usage.name: 🐓 Just the tip.
usage.desc: Write it into a story line. Just the tip, though.

usage.name: 😏 Smutty Buddy
usage.desc: Get a moan into the story.

usage.name: One Last Time.
usage.desc: Let Vecna say his name. Write “William” into a story line.

usage.name: He's coming for you
usage.desc: Write “Vecna” into a story line. At long last, we can begin.

usage.name: 🌀 If We're Both Going Crazy
usage.desc: Write “crazy together” into a story line.

usage.name: Mouth Breather
usage.desc: Write “stupid” or “mouth breather” into a story line. Ugh.

usage.name: 💩 Resume it, Stupid
usage.desc: Try to write while the game is paused. Resume it, stupid.

usageOpen.name: 🖋 Opening Line
usageOpen.desc: Start something classic: write “once upon a time” into a story line.

_gimmickReadme: Gimmicks are not mapped here: each gimmick belongs to a THEME (the `theme` field on its GIMMICKS entry in lib/gimmicks.js) and unlocks with that theme's tier in themeUnlocks above, retier the theme and its gimmick moves with it. A gimmick whose theme is unlisted (free) is free. test/gimmicks.test.mjs pins the derivation.
_themeReadme: themeUnlocks maps a theme id (see THEMES in public/js/theme.js) to the wordTiers id that unlocks it. A theme NOT listed here is free for everyone. An unknown tier id also reads as free. Admins see every theme regardless. Hand-edit freely: test/themes.test.mjs fails if a key is not a real theme.
